```{r setup, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, results = 'hide', include = FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library("ggplot2")
  library("readr")
  library("dplyr")
  library("tidyr")
  library("magrittr")
  library("reshape2")
  library("viridis")
})

# --- Data paths ---
url_manifest                 <- "../data/manifest.txt"
url_preanalytical_conditions <- "../data/pre-analytical_conditions.txt"
url_hpv_type                 <- "../data/TM-2021-MSK-002_HPV_Typing_WES_WGS.txt"
url_clinical                 <- "../data/clinical.txt"
url_mutation_summary         <- "../data/mutation_summary.maf"
url_idx_metrics_ft           <- "../data/idx_metrics_ft.txt"

target_contigs <- c(
  "HPV-16" = "NC001526.4",
  "HPV-18" = "NC001357.1",
  "HPV-31" = "J04353.1",
  "HPV-33" = "M12732.1",
  "HPV-35" = "X74477.1"
)

FRAGMENT_LENGTH_THRESHOLD <- 37
```

```{r load_shared_data, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}

manifest_raw <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_manifest, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(bam_file_name_hpv)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample_uuid = paste0(sample_id_mskcc, "-", sample_id_invitae))

preanalytical_conditions <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_preanalytical_conditions, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert()

hpv_smry <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_hpv_type, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient_id_mskcc = gsub("-T", "", patient_name, fixed = TRUE),
    patient_id_mskcc = gsub("155salv", "155", patient_id_mskcc, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes     = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_wes, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wgs     = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_wgs, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_wes_wgs, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs = dplyr::coalesce(hpv_type_wes_wgs, "Unknown")
  )

manifest <- manifest_raw %>%
  dplyr::left_join(preanalytical_conditions, by = "sample_id_mskcc") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient_id_mskcc = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(patient_id_mskcc) & sample_id_mskcc == "21-144-03654" ~ "CTMS-164",
      TRUE ~ patient_id_mskcc
    ),
    sample_name = paste0(sample_id_mskcc, "-", sample_id_invitae)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(hpv_smry, by = "patient_id_mskcc")

mutation_smry <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_mutation_summary, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert()

clinical <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_clinical, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert()

# --- Per-sample mutation AF summary ---
mut_af_smry <- mutation_smry %>%
  dplyr::filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean_af = mean(t_maf), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rename(sample_name = Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

# --- Index metrics at target fragment length, with HPV type and AF joined ---
idx_metrics_ft <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_idx_metrics_ft, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_name     = SAMPLE_NAME,
    contig          = CHROMOSOME,
    aligned_reads   = ALIGNED_READS,
    fragment_length = FRAGMENT_LENGTH
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::tibble(contig = target_contigs, chromosome = names(target_contigs)),
    by = "contig"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(fragment_length == FRAGMENT_LENGTH_THRESHOLD, !is.na(chromosome)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(manifest, by = "sample_name") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::select(clinical, patient_id_mskcc, hpv_type_panel),
    by = "patient_id_mskcc"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    hpv_type_panel       = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_panel, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel = dplyr::case_when(
      hpv_type_wes_wgs == "Unknown" ~ hpv_type_panel,
      TRUE ~ hpv_type_wes_wgs
    ),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel = dplyr::coalesce(hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel, "Unknown")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(chromosome == hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mut_af_smry, by = "sample_name") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT = floor(timepoint_days_since_start_of_RT / 7),
    timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT = dplyr::case_when(
      timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT < 0 ~ "Pre-treatment",
      TRUE ~ paste0("wk", timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT)
    )
  )
```

```{r build_plots_S12, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}

# --- Helper: pivot a per-patient per-timepoint summary to wide format ---
# Returns a tibble with abs_<prefix>_wk0-3 and rel_<prefix>_wk1-3 columns.
# Pre-filter df before passing if needed (e.g. HPV-16 only).
make_wide <- function(df, value_col, prefix) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(patient_id_mskcc, timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(v = mean(.data[[value_col]] + 1e-5, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    reshape2::dcast(
      formula       = patient_id_mskcc ~ timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT,
      fun.aggregate = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      fill          = NaN,
      value.var     = "v"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id_mskcc, `Pre-treatment`, wk1, wk2, wk3) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      !!paste0("rel_", prefix, "_wk1") := wk1 / `Pre-treatment`,
      !!paste0("rel_", prefix, "_wk2") := wk2 / `Pre-treatment`,
      !!paste0("rel_", prefix, "_wk3") := wk3 / `Pre-treatment`
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk0") := `Pre-treatment`,
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk1") := wk1,
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk2") := wk2,
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk3") := wk3
    )
}

# --- Helper: run univariate GLM (probit) for each variable against one outcome ---
run_glm <- function(smry_long, outcome_col) {
  uvars <- unique(smry_long$variable)
  vapply(uvars, function(v) {
    tryCatch({
      (smry_long %>%
        dplyr::filter(variable == v) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(value = log2(value)) %>%
        stats::glm(
          formula = as.formula(paste(outcome_col, "~ value")),
          data    = .,
          family  = binomial(link = "probit")
        ) %>%
        summary() %>%
        .[["coefficients"]])[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }, numeric(1))
}

# --- Helper: run Wilcoxon test for each variable against one outcome ---
run_wilcox <- function(smry_long, outcome_col) {
  uvars <- unique(smry_long$variable)
  vapply(uvars, function(v) {
    tryCatch({
      smry_long %>%
        dplyr::filter(variable == v) %>%
        wilcox.test(
          formula = as.formula(paste("value ~", outcome_col)),
          data    = .,
          exact   = FALSE
        ) %>%
        .[["p.value"]]
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }, numeric(1))
}

# --- Build long summary table ---
wide_af  <- make_wide(idx_metrics_ft, "mean_af", "AF")
wide_hpv <- make_wide(
  dplyr::filter(idx_metrics_ft, hpv_type_wes_wgs == "HPV-16"),
  "aligned_reads", "HPV"
)

smry_ <- wide_af %>%
  dplyr::full_join(wide_hpv, by = "patient_id_mskcc") %>%
  dplyr::full_join(clinical, by = "patient_id_mskcc") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient_id_mskcc,
    composite_end_point, neck_dissection_yes_no, hypoxia_resolution,
    abs_AF_wk0,  abs_AF_wk1,  abs_AF_wk2,  abs_AF_wk3,
    rel_AF_wk1,  rel_AF_wk2,  rel_AF_wk3,
    abs_HPV_wk0, abs_HPV_wk1, abs_HPV_wk2, abs_HPV_wk3,
    rel_HPV_wk1, rel_HPV_wk2, rel_HPV_wk3,
    abs_MRI_wk0 = MRI_rawdata_wk0,
    abs_MRI_wk1 = MRI_rawdata_wk2,   # one-week imaging offset
    abs_MRI_wk2 = MRI_rawdata_wk3,
    abs_MRI_wk3 = MRI_rawdata_wk4
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rel_MRI_wk1         = abs_MRI_wk1 / abs_MRI_wk0,
    rel_MRI_wk2         = abs_MRI_wk2 / abs_MRI_wk0,
    rel_MRI_wk3         = abs_MRI_wk3 / abs_MRI_wk0,
    composite_end_point = dplyr::if_else(composite_end_point, 1L, 0L),
    neck_dissection_yes_no = dplyr::case_when(
      neck_dissection_yes_no == "yes" ~ "1",
      neck_dissection_yes_no == "no"  ~ "0"
    ),
    hypoxia_resolution = dplyr::case_when(
      hypoxia_resolution == "persistent" ~ "1",
      hypoxia_resolution == "resolved"   ~ "0"
    )
  ) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::select(-patient_id_mskcc) %>%
  reshape2::melt(
    id.vars = c("composite_end_point", "neck_dissection_yes_no", "hypoxia_resolution")
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

uvars <- unique(smry_$variable)

# --- Compute p-values (GLM probit and Wilcoxon) for all three outcomes ---
p1 <- run_glm(smry_,    "composite_end_point")
p2 <- run_glm(smry_,    "neck_dissection_yes_no")
p3 <- run_glm(smry_,    "hypoxia_resolution")
q1 <- run_wilcox(smry_, "composite_end_point")
q2 <- run_wilcox(smry_, "neck_dissection_yes_no")
q3 <- run_wilcox(smry_, "hypoxia_resolution")

# Baseline wk0 rows for relative variables (p = 1 by definition)
baseline_rows <- dplyr::tibble(
  variables              = rep(c("rel_AF_wk0", "rel_MRI_wk0", "rel_HPV_wk0"), 2),
  `De-escalation failure` = 1,
  `PET response`          = 1,
  `Risk group`            = 1,
  Method                  = rep(c("log", "u"), each = 3)
)

res_ <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::tibble(
    variables              = uvars,
    `De-escalation failure` = p2,
    `PET response`          = p3,
    `Risk group`            = p1,
    Method                  = "log"
  ),
  dplyr::tibble(
    variables              = uvars,
    `De-escalation failure` = q2,
    `PET response`          = q3,
    `Risk group`            = q1,
    Method                  = "u"
  ),
  baseline_rows
)

plot_ <- res_ %>%
  dplyr::filter(Method == "log") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Method) %>%
  reshape2::melt() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    value = p.adjust(value, method = "BH"),
    week  = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("wk0", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Pre-treat\n-ment",
      grepl("wk1", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Week 1",
      grepl("wk2", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Week 2",
      grepl("wk3", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Week 3"
    ),
    assay = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("AF",  variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "PCM",
      grepl("HPV", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "HPV",
      grepl("MRI", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "MRI"
    ),
    mode = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("rel", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Relative",
      grepl("abs", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Absolute"
    ),
    mode     = factor(mode,     levels = c("Absolute", "Relative"), ordered = TRUE),
    assay    = factor(assay,    levels = c("HPV", "PCM", "MRI"),   ordered = TRUE),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = c("Risk group", "PET response", "De-escalation failure"), ordered = TRUE),
    log_value = dplyr::case_when(
      week == "Pre-treat\n-ment" & mode == "Relative" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ -log10(value)
    ),
    value = dplyr::case_when(
      week == "Pre-treat\n-ment" & mode == "Relative" ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ value
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-variables) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = variable, fill = log_value, label = signif(value, 2))) +
  geom_tile(stat = "identity", color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(color = "white", size = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis(breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 1.45, by = 0.35)) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x     = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 20), size = 12),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 20), size = 12),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  facet_grid(mode ~ assay) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title = expression(-Log[10](q))))
```
